# Collect song IDs from all liked playlists (paginate liked playlists fully; fetch playlist details for song list)
liked_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('liked_playlists:', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], len(p.get('song_ids',[]))) for p in liked_playlists])

song_map = {}  # song_id -> {'title':..., 'artists':[...]} from show_playlist
for p in liked_playlists:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    print('playlist', p['playlist_id'], 'songs returned', len(songs))
    for s in songs:
        sid = s.get('id')
        song_map[sid] = {
            'title': s.get('title'),
            'artists': [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])]
        }

song_ids = sorted(song_map.keys())
print('unique song_ids to rate:', len(song_ids))
print('first 10:', song_ids[:10])

email = account['email']

not_five = []
missing = []

for sid in song_ids:
    # fetch all reviews for this song
    all_reviews = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    my_review = None
    for r in all_reviews:
        if (r.get('user') or {}).get('email') == email:
            my_review = r
            break
    if not my_review:
        missing.append(sid)
    else:
        rating = my_review.get('rating')
        if rating is None or float(rating) != 5.0:
            not_five.append((sid, my_review.get('song_review_id'), rating, my_review.get('title')))

print('total songs:', len(song_ids))
print('missing reviews:', len(missing))
print('not 5 reviews:', len(not_five))
print('sample not five:', not_five[:5])
